tools.description:
Get Category Vendors

Get ranked vendor leaderboard within a category.
Returns per-vendor adoption rates, spend share, growth metrics, and competitive rankings.
Note: competitor_switch_rate is the share of within-category switchers who chose this vendor (a win rate among switchers), NOT a retention or churn rate.
Example: {"category": "CRM", "limit": 10}.
Call ramp_rate_list_categories first to discover valid category names.
